name: la posta creek cliff swallows
notes: lovely cliff swallow vocalizations beneath the bridge over la posta creek. cars passing by on buckman springs rd. my first recording :)

name: wind in grass
notes: desert grass swirling in the wind with air and car traffic in the distance

name: desert wind
notes: still settling in to what i'm recording out here. everything is new for the eyes, ears, mind, and body. let my ears be my guide.

name: san ysidro creek night chorus
notes: considered stopping here for the night, but kept moving after recording. a friendly campsite with beautiful frog chorusing not so far away. i felt the tension between keeping up with my new friends and following my ears on this night. split the diffrence and made a brief recording before continuing on for the night.

name: agua caliente creek 1
notes: knee pains and feeling a bit lonely already. stopped along agua caliente to record and get some rest before catching up to the group for the night.

name: agua caliente creek 2
notes: the cricket and frog chorusing was worth extending my night for here. a welcome quiet space.
content: creek, frog, cricket, bird, water, insect

name: agua caliente creek 3
notes: another lovely water and frog chorusing soundscape along agua caliente creek

name: redshanks in heavy wind 1
notes: adenostoma sparsifolium creaking nicely
content: heavy, wind, creaking branch, bird, desert

name: a yucca vantage
notes: clipped my mics onto a yucca

name: redshanks in heavy wind 2
notes: heavy wind but nicely protected here

name: fobes trail jct
notes: cowboy camping just below a ridge. nicely shielded from the wind. thx yotes!

name: devil's slide stream
notes: lovely snowmelt while heading down into idyllwild. my first town day awaits :)

name: black mountain road snowmelt
notes: tree ears on a massive ponderosa for peak snowfall immersion. palm springs in the distance.

name: palm springs windfarm
notes: finally got to the windfarm and recording a pct landmark. sitting in the colorado desert having just descended from the snowy san jacintos. it is hot, windy, exposed, and i'm getting absolutely sandblasted. hikers passing by as i record the ominous drones of the palm springs windfarm.
content: wind, transmission lines, electric, plane, hiker, sand, windfarm, windmill, desert

name: mission creek 1
notes: i remember taking a moment here after crossing cission creek a bunch to break up the monotony of the day. a hot slog, the soundscape was more captivating than the landscape here.

name: mission creek 2
notes: another vantage of mission creek. enjoying the water on this hot, hot day.

name: mission creek field of bees
notes: i felt like a field recordist here, out in the middle of the desert. very hot. middle of the afternoon. hikers pass by. i'm realizing more and more how field recording will impact my trip and vice versa.

name: mission creek birdsong
notes: i have no memory of this place :D

name: on the outskirts of big bear
notes: i clipped my microphones to some sagebrush outside of big bear. taking an opportunity to record while i wait for my friends :)

name: transmission lines + cricket chorus
notes: transmission lines and cricket chorusing in the morning on the way into cajon pass. i think i can stop to recording and still make breakfast at mcdonalds :)

name: reservoir fence + construction
notes: decidedly not a nature soundscape, but i found the rickety fence totally captivating in the moment. if it fits it sits.

name: morning on baden-powell
notes: i intended to summit for sunrise, but ended up spending time here to record instead. a peaceful moment before beelining it through snow to the summit. traffic in the distance.

name: inside my tent
notes: camped on a ridge, windsounds through the valley. sprained my ankle badly the next day, which took me off trail for a couple weeks. end of chapter 1.

name: in the tall grass
notes: first day back on trail. thx gina <3

name: dawn chorus through the marine layer
notes: one of the more memorable recording locations in the desert. wanted more time here but had to move on. birdsong reflecting through the marine layer. mourning dove, spotted towhee, mountain quail, and others. nice, moody reverberations.

name: wind on the firebreak
notes: intense wind on the grass mountain firebreak. spent some time dialing in gain settings and learning more about how my tiny lom + sony rig handles very dynamic and exposed soundscapes.

name: immersive bees
notes: longform bee recording in desert scrub. lake hughes area traffic in the distance.

name: dusk chorus
notes: a reverberous dusk chorus with crickets

name: mountain quail dialogue
notes: mountain quails call and response across a vast distance. poodle-dog bush gauntlet day!

name: birds and bees
notes: a very full and active soundscape in the fish canyon area

name: creosote katydids
notes: aqueduct night. i sat alone on the floor of the mojave recording this in total darkness. a peak experience. best guess is Insara covilleae.
content: katydid, insect, breeze, wind turbine, desert

name: inside an underground cistern
notes: recording through the holes of a concrete underground cistern at camp

name: on the edge of the windfarm
notes: recording on the outskirts of the manzana wind farm at camp

name: windmills in the mojave 1
notes: on aqueduct road, starting the manzana windfarm stretch in antelope valley, windmill is 60-75ft in front of me

name: windmills in the mojave 2
notes: i've never been this close to an active wind turbine before. i'm sitting directly underneath the path of the blade, and it's passing through the center of the stereo field.

name: windmills in the mojave 3
notes: a field of wind turbines highlighted by high-pitched whistletones coming from one of the turbines. birdsong somehow persists here, occupying a higher register than the prevailing drones of the windfarm.

name: windmills in the mojave 4
notes: another vantage of the whistling turbine in the previous recording

name: an intense windbreak
notes: i really loved recording here. the tree patch had perfect shielding from the wind, which was nice for both recording and my desire to get out of the wind for a bit. i would've left my mics here all night if i could've

name: windstorm gusts inside my tent
notes: an excerpt of a very intense windstorm from inside my tent. tent collapsed shortly after this. still a fun night. i forgot i had packed out a modelo and enjoyed it thoroughly. tehachapi pass windfarm in the distance.

name: windfarm descent into tehachapi
notes: last set of turbines before tehachapi. it is hot and i'm ready for a town day.

name: birdsong in a valley
notes: so peaceful here. it's the echo of mountain quails that really does it for me.

name: a cowboy vantage
notes: this was a pretty sweet and expansive camp. i remember a bunch of folks in the clearing across trail, and i took a solo cowboy spot in the trees. lots of camp options. the sunsets are getting totally excellent

name: a forested dawn chorus
notes: a very chatty morning scene

name: birdsong in a peaceful forest
notes: this is a longer recording i trimmed to 1 minute due to air traffic. i wonder how much time i spent recording sound that would never make it onto the map.

name: a welcome light rain
notes: i think this was the first rain of trail, and only lasted a few minutes!

name: cottonwood creek
notes: a light, calm stream and tree wind soundscape

name: desert breeze among the joshua trees
notes: stopped to record the desert soundscape in the heat. feeling very immersed in the environment. dune vibes.

name: mojave thunder 2
notes: took a walk down the road from the water cache to record the sound of rolling thunder in the distance. a black throated sparrow takes interest.

name: walker pass approach
notes: walking descent to walker pass campground

name: walker pass wind
notes: intense wind on the first ridge out of walker pass. this was a great spot to stop and record. perfect wind protection in the bushes. the wind almost swept me off my feet. totally incredible.

name: nighttime cricket chorus
notes: chorus at my camp on walker pass day. sitting out with my red light on. good times :)

name: spanish needle creek
notes: stopped to grab some water and record this beautiful creek before anyone catches up :)

name: one last night in the desert
notes: last night in the desert and it is totally quiet out here. congrats tom <3

name: cicada chorus 1
notes: walked a little S of camp to record the cicadas before heading to KMS and finishing up the desert :)

name: cicada chorus 2
notes: a second recording of the cicadas. changed position and staging to deal with all the flies

name: south fork of the kern river 1
notes: kern river just before KMS

name: kennedy meadows insect chorus
notes: last recording of the desert section! clouds and tiptoe spotted me during this. we friended up and left for cottonwood pass with dubs the next day.

name: south fork of the kern river 2
notes: first day out of KMS into the south sierra wilderness. hiking w tiptoe, clouds, and dubs. suspended my mics off the bridge and down toward the river surface.

name: snow walk to cottonwood pass trail junction
notes: a snowy and sluggish approach to cottonwood pass

name: terminal geyser 1
notes: first vantage of terminal geyser

name: terminal geyser 2
notes: second vantage of terminal geyser

name: terminal geyser 3
notes: third vantage of terminal geyser

name: olive-sided flycatcher
notes: quick three beers! dixie fire burn scar in lassen volcanic wilderness, featuring an olive-sided flycatcher. a steller's jay makes an appearance. very, very quiet out here.

name: morning chorusing along hot springs creek
notes: very active bird and cricket chorusing. comforted by how incredibly picturesque this spot was. so beautiful.

name: bees in a creekbed
notes: standing among the bees in the creekbed. i stayed as long as i could, until they started crawling up my legs. really enjoyed making this recording

name: hat creek rim
notes: hot

name: nighttime tent recording
notes: short rec from inside my tent, at cache 22

name: hat creek rim descent
notes: farmland in the middle of nowheresville. feeling really, really out there

name: transmission lines + quail
notes: stopped to record here because of the clear cut transmission lines, a not-so-happy quail, and a temperature of 102°F. totally brutal.

name: burney falls
notes: the mist from the falls was so welcome today!

name: bees in flower bush 2
notes: another immersive bee swarm in a big flowering bush

name: deer creek 1
notes: a lyrical pacific wren with beautiful creek noise in the background

name: deer creek 2
notes: further along deer creek offers a totally different acoustic vantage from the first recording

name: pine forest + valley
notes: an acoustically spacious forested valley with birdsong, insects, and creek noise in the far background. starring a black-headed grosbeak.

name: a gentle breeze
notes: wind in an expansive forest space, happy 4th :)

name: bees in flower bush 3
notes: a very large and very active colony of bees  <3

name: mumbo basin thunder
notes: sitting atop a large boulder recording thunder in the valley. my vertigo was put to the test here, for some reason :/

name: hermit thrush 2
notes: a hermit thrush call glistening front and center. a tree sways in the wind, creaking nearby.

name: trinity alps snowmelt
notes: this pretty creek drainage had lush, green grass eminating from its banks, distinguishing it from the drier foliage in the area. totally idylic.

name: trinity alps grasshoppers 1
notes: a field of grasshoppers. a yellow-rumped warbler joins

name: trinity alps grasshoppers 2
notes: more grasshoppers

name: trinity alps grasshoppers 5
notes: tree ears recording in a peaceful forest. great stereo image.

name: delicate spring
notes: the smallest water sources are often the most enchanting. feeling pretty magical out here

name: snowmelt waterfall 1
notes: a healthy stream waterfall over the trail. so much water out here

name: snowmelt waterfall 2
notes: a larger stream waterfall with grasshoppers in the background

name: snowmelt in the caves
notes: inside a karst system around black marble mountain. a massive ice plug roofed the top of the entrance, slowly melting. it was nice and cool with a slight breeze. not safe and i do not recommend doing this.

name: grasshoppers, birds among the pines
notes: open field surrounded by conifers. pretty roomsound. bees everywhere.

name: a lone jeffrey pine in the wind
notes: wind sounds through a lone jeffrey pine. an exposed location just outside of seiad valley. mics laying on the ground facing up toward the tree.

name: hermit thrush dialog
notes: hermit thrushes during dusk chorus. i love their song.

name: cowbells in the valley
notes: cowbells in a valley below trail the night before hitting the oregon border. an unexpected and heartwarming soundscape in the moment. the approach to ashland was so beautiful and it really felt like the landscape was changing.

name: hermit thrush
notes: multiple hermit thrushes calling. their song might be the official theme of NorCal for me :)

name: a grazing cow
notes: a cow eating grass. walking, snorting, undeterred by my presence.

name: an insect chorus at observation gap
notes: a tree ears recording with a nice stereo image. welcome to oregon!

name: a colony in the wildflowers
notes: mics laying on a dirt/wildflower hillside, lots of bees and flys swarming around. i got stung here :/

name: cascade canal 1
notes: after a lazy nap and some unexpected pizza trail magic, a recording of cascade canal.

name: cascade canal 2
notes: another recording of cascade canal from a different vantage

name: cricket closeup
notes: late-night recording of a cricket and some oregon mosquitoes :)

name: a confluence of streams
notes: four streams converge into one

name: a booming nighthawk
notes: tree ears recording. i staged the mics in the flakes of bark on a large pine. a nighthawk booms and takes me by surprise. crickets are prominent.

name: tent chorus
notes: crickets just outside of my tent at a stealthy location. they were very loud and there was one right by my head the entire night.

name: a stream in diamond peak wilderness
notes: another beautiful little OR stream, mics are suspended over the stream

name: cedar creek moonscape
notes: an epic moonscape at sunset. wind sounds on a glowing, desolate landscape as the temperature drops. a woodpecker knocks. i've never seen anything like this until today. otherworldly and completely solitary. simultaneously heartbreaking and awe-inspiring. i crossed paths with one sobo as soon as i started recording here. getting off-trail tomorrow to move across country. back soon to continue north with the 8020's :)

name: timberline spring
notes: a spring just outside of timberline. first recording with the 8020/F3 rig. i forgot a memory card and carried the rig all the way here from elk lake without recording anything. oh well. really happy to continue on with this rig for the remainder of the hike.

name: zigzag river
notes: took some time to record before crossing. really enjoying making my way around mt. hood

name: ramona falls 1
notes: base of ramona falls, 30-40ft from base. i have this zone all to myself for the evening :)

name: ramona falls 2
notes: base of ramona falls, 12ft from base

name: ramona creek
notes: a tranquil moment in the ramona falls loop

name: muddy fork
notes: wind blowing through the trees, sandy river in the distance

name: forest wind along a ridge 1
notes: wind blowing through the trees

name: forest wind along a ridge 2
notes: this is just before the eagle creek alternate; intense wind blowing up the ridge i'm on top of, great wind protection from the trees, i remember turning a corner just after this and the wind vanished completely

name: eagle creek wind through trees 2
notes: more intesnse wind through treees. it is a very windy day out here today

name: eagle creek cricket chorus 1
notes: insect chorus on the eagle creek alternate. i wish i would've recorded here longer--for some reason i got the creep and decided i just needed to get to camp.

name: eagle creek cricket chorus 2
notes: recording just outside of my camp, i wish i would've stopped for longer on the eagle creek alt leading up to this but it was non-ideal hiking: i was tired, it was dark, and the trail was dusty, washed out, and super overgrown. more like a bushwhack at times. i fwas getting creeped out that something big was around, too. who knows.

name: eagle creek 1
notes: eagle creek, 20ft back

name: eagle creek 2
notes: eagle creek, right at the creek

notes: tunnel falls, 20 ft distance, adjacent to the falls

notes: tunnel falls, 100ft back, at the bend, looking at the falls

name: tunnel falls 3
notes: tunnel falls, midpoint, 50-60ft away

name: wind through yacolt burn state forest
notes: welcome to washington!

name: snag creek
notes: a calming recording of snag creek. washington feeling different already. some hikers i've never seen before passed by. anticipating what's ahead.

name: small stream dropping into lush valley
notes: lush and intimate location. great acoustics, wish i had more time to record here.

name: panther creek ascent 1
notes: washington feeling like a new chapter. hiking alone. siesta'ed here before moving onto the bridge to record.

name: panther creek ascent 2
notes: climbing out of the creek valley. nice acoustics

name: wind in the huckleberries
notes: so many huckleberries :D

name: east crater regrowth ambience
notes: burn regrowth in a dreary cloud. fireweed highlights the landscape with its pops of vibrant magenta. visually captivating.

name: a groaning tree
notes: a massive tree groans in the wind. condensation dropping all around. i've spent the day in a cloud

name: mosquito creek 2
notes: creek running underneath the trail, mics suspended over the creek by hand

name: trout lake creek
notes: so calm out here. thankfully no mosquitoes right now.

name: the wind around mt adams
notes: mics facing out of my tent entrance, wind howling through the valley outside of trout lake. i'm about to have a hard day

name: canopy drip in a mossy forest with bees
notes: cold and rainy day north of trout lake, this location was simply beautiful

name: goat rocks summit 2
notes: goat rocks summit at 2AM. i camped a couple hundred feet below the summit and my tent collapsed from wind in the middle of the night. after repitching, i took the opportunity to record at the top.

name: knifes edge valley
notes: a beautiful sunny morning on the knifes edge, recording into the stunning valley until mousetrap and stir show up. today we start hiking washington together <3

name: layers of wind
notes: a nice green noise soundscape with sparse birdsong

name: bumping river
notes: a beautiful, mossy creek soundscape in a dense forest

name: raindrops in a cloud
notes: condensation falling from trees on soft ground in a lush forest. i'm sitting on a log in a cloud. beautiful. lovely.

name: dewey lake shoreline
notes: water along the shore of dewey lake in mt. rainer national park

name: sourdough gap wind
notes: wind in the valley, on the descent after the sourdough gap climb. i caught up to mousetrap part way up the climb where he was taking lunch. he left as i was showing up. i dried my stuff out and had lunch there before continuing on for the day

name: birdsong in a dense forest
notes: dense forest in a cloud with lots of active chatter. i took a deeply enjoyable moment to step off trail and record our bird friends here.

name: birds and bees in a quiet forest
notes: nice acoustics here. the drone of bees ever-present.

name: mirror lake great-horned owl 4
notes: a great-horned owl calls across mirror lake. begrudgingly, i got up in the middle of the night to record a little bit of our nighttime visitor.

name: grasshoppers in the wind
notes: layers of wind and grasshoppers

name: lemah creek
notes: i sat on the bank of this creek in the shadow of the bridge and near a giant boulder during this rec. feeling sad and overwhelmed after getting bit by the dog earlier. super hot out, but incredibly cool with a slight breeze down by the water. a gem of a spot.

name: above lemah meadow
notes: distant green noise ambience from the valley below with birdsong above

name: sooty grouse
notes: a sooty grouse nearby with varied calls

name: water dripping down side of rock face
notes: really interesting rock face with water dripping off of it. anita caught up to me while i was recording here. congrats on the calendar year, anita! it's my 38th birthday today <3

name: nice marmot
notes: marmots whistling below me into a beautiful valle. really great echo

name: a quiet morning above lake janus
notes: AM climb out of lake janus, i remember we were easily triggered by rain at this point, not wanting to deal with it anymore

name: raining from the trees
notes: a charming pine grove in a cloud, raining in the trees from all the condensation. a storybook recording spot

name: white chuck fork
notes: a steep drainage while descending to white chuck river. shaded with a cool breeze, absolutely perfect temperature. steep with gigantic mossy logs everywhere. so, so nice.

name: white chuck ambience 1
notes: i remember how mossy and soft it was here, a little ways away from the bridge over the white chuck river. sonically very calm and soothing. visually tender and beautiful. the ground was so very spongey with root systems creating dramatic little hills blanketed with pine duff

name: white chuck ambience 2
notes: i was excited to record here but the mosquitos were more troublesome than i anticipated. i just gotten stung a couple minutes before and feeling a little shaken. mic perspective is from on top of a large, downed tree

name: looking into a canyon
notes: an introspective vantage. i had a nice, deep cry here. it was a good moment. happy i kept going--i cowboyed on top of fire creek pass and it was one of the more immersive and epic camps of the hike

name: suiattle river
notes: glacier peak wilderness. mics suspended down over the suiattle river. despite peeing brown just before this, it was one of the most magical days on trail. listening to braiding sweetgrass while making my way through the old-growth jungle gym. i will cherish this time forever.

name: miners creek ambience 1
notes: muted green noise above miners creek with sparse birdsong

name: miners creek ambience 2
notes: another slightly brighter ambience of miners creek

name: a stream beneath the rocks 1
notes: the snowmelt was cascading down the side of the mountain and running underneath a field of rocks, underfoot

name: a stream beneath the rocks 2
notes: a second vantage of the underground snowmelt stream

name: methow pass
notes: one day north of stehekin, just completely immersed in the beauty of washington.

name: windy pass
notes: feeling very remote sitting here right at the pasayten wilderness sign. mics staged on the ground facing up. it is cold and wet out.

name: canopy snowmelt
notes: windy and cold today. feeling really dialed in on recording and being a recordist in tune with the earth. still need to make miles, though. mic vantage from on the ground. my last recording before tagging the northern terminus.

name: a brief moment in the north cascades
notes: a short recording from an idyllic view

name: holman pass
notes: tucked away by myself ascending holman pass. lots of bird chatter over the bed of droning bees. a woodpecker knocks in the distance.

name: woolly mules ear
notes: first day headed sobo in the sierra from darrell's place. thanks darrell! just south of carson pass. waves of dried, dead woolly mules ears waving in the breeze.

name: birds in a valley
notes: a nice moment with a townsend's solitaire kept short, wanting to stay ahead of the incoming storm

name: lyell fork ambience
notes: lyell fork green noise ambience in the distance. hazel and i starting our ascent of the north face of donahue pass

name: a small stream
notes: a quiet moment with hazel. ascending donahue, almost to ansel adams wilderness <3

name: fish creek
notes: mics suspended over fish creek bridge

name: mono creek and birds
notes: a short recording of mono creek in the distance, sparse birdsong overhead

name: above mono creek
notes: took a break in the switchbacks to stop and record the wash of mono creek down in the distance. someone's not too happy i stopped here. sorry, friend :)

name: gently quaking aspens
notes: my only recording of quaking aspens on the hike. while i wanted to get more, i'm happy i have this one

name: mcclure meadow
notes: in the middle of mcclure meadow across from the ranger station. absolutely vast and beautiful. evolution creek in the distance.

name: wanda lake
notes: some water quietly lapping on the shore of wanda lake. evolution valley is incredible.

name: along the middle fork of the kings river
notes: a bed of green noise from the nearby kings river. a grasshopper stridulating. a magical past couple of days <3

name: dusy switchbacks
notes: climbing out of leconte canyon toward dusy basin. a welcome break in the shade. active birdsong among the wash of the kings river below.

name: mather pass
notes: a gentle, sparse soundscape atop mather pass

name: white fork inlet
notes: more excellent sierra water <3 woods creek in the distance

name: kearsarge trail jct
notes: had a peaceful morning descending glen pass. sitting in the wide open near the kearsarge pass trail jct.

name: forester pass
notes: an exceptionally good day in the high country. sitting alone on the summit of forester. i have some slight vertigo up here, but still enjoying these moments thoroughly

name: mt whitney
notes: beyond incredible meteor shower last night--i think i've entered the magic zone. it feels good to be up here, finally. this recording is facing NW. HB michelle <3

name: whitney creek
notes: a wonderfully gentle whitney creek, post-mt. whitney summit. i took a mental note of this spot on my way up, and stopped to record on the way back.

name: rock creek ambience
notes: AM animal chatter. rock creek in the distance. just being in this pine forest. another incredible meteor shower display last night.

name: desolation snowmelt
notes: first day nobo out of tahoe. thanks again, darrell! a snowstorm rolled through last night, and i'm not carrying any traction. eek. snow melting from the trees in desolation wilderness.

name: castle pass wind
notes: high wind through castle pass area, just north of hwy 80 and truckee. nice heavy wind rec. insanely windy and snowy on the approach to truckee. what a trip.

name: milton creek
notes: finally out of the snow! used a stump to stage the mics w a bit of stereo separation. a nice recording spot with tree coverage and pleasant daytime temp.

name: sierra city crickets 1
notes: wanted to catch these crickets because i hadn't heard any in a while. very happy to be out of the tahoe snow. north yuba river in the distance.

name: sierra city crickets 2
notes: recorded this right next to the road going into sierra city. general store owner almost didn't open today, and the owner figured i might be the last person he sees this season. wild! north yuba river in the distance.

name: tent windstorm
notes: brutal windstorm this night. normally wouldn't camp here but i was zapped. tent collapsed twice. slept terribly. views in the AM were exquisite, though.

name: insects at dusk
notes: stopped right on trail to record what i think are katydids. almost done for the night.

name: great-horned owl
notes: maybe my favorite recording of the trek. i ended the recording just before the male showed up due to core temp concerns. an incredibly tender dialog ensued between the two of them. i'll never forget just how excited the female was when the male showed up. heartbreakingly beautiful. a nat geo moment.

name: afternoon cricket chorus
notes: first cricket chorus of the day, approaching the descent toward the feather river. an epic evening of cricket chorusing.

name: feather river insect chorus 1
notes: a lovely evening chorus, descending into the middle fork of the feather river. such a magical evening.

name: feather river insect chorus 2
notes: another cricket chorus vantage. i moved 100ft from the previous recording to get a deeper, less localized soundscape. a calm evening heading into camp. HB gina <3

name: woodpecker and red-breasted nuthatch
notes: high canopy forest with a beautiful open understory. a woodpecker knocks while red-breasted nuthatches call around me

name: insect reflections
notes: insect reflections through a cool, trenchy, rocky section on the climb out of belden. really unique reflections i just had to stop and record. chip creek sounding in the distance.

name: chip creek ambience
notes: recording while cowboying. the full rec has an audio journal entry in it, and it made me think i should've done that more. nestled in a duff-y nook, i felt so at one with and supported by the earth. i got giardia from the stream to the S :(

name: dixie fire ambience 1
notes: wind through the burn scar. i probably shouldn't have lingered so long here, but i had a truly immersive experience in doing so.

name: dixie fire ambience 2
notes: a great wind recording. mics facing up from ground perspective via some rock stands i put together. a tree shedding event nearby gives a nice sense of scale to the space. really lovely green noise and acoustics.

name: rain on dyneema composite fabric
notes: recorded inside my tent. i camped down low off trail to get out of the wind. the pin drop piercing sound of rain drops on dcf.

name: AM forest ambience
notes: recording from camp before heading out for the day. i thought this would be the last recording of my hike and made an emotional statement at the end to commemorate. my recorder lost power part way through and my words were lost. so it goes :)

name: trees creaking in heavy wind 2
notes: one more recording before finishing this adventure of a lifetime. congrats, stereo <3
